frontText: Navy 65 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Indian Ocean haven
items.placementTarget: Board, in the Indian Ocean east of Africa, on the printed intersection of 0° and 60°E.
items.text:
Name and access
this haven and
open 11 the first
time you move
here.

havens.graticule: The anchor sits on the printed 0° parallel and on the printed 60°E meridian, which passes through the disc. The 60°E label is printed below the name plate.
havens.namePlate: Blank white name plate directly below the anchor, with a pointer up to the disc.

redRegionLines: A vertical red line runs the full height of the ocean along the left side of the sticker, just east of the yellow African coast and west of the haven.

specialAreas.name: eastern tint
specialAreas.notes: The right side of the ocean is washed pink where the sticker meets the Middle East sheet. Not a red region line. No sea lane is printed.

mechanics.onFirstMove: Name and access this haven and open door 11.
mechanics.notes: Population 3. Port. Blank name. No printed sea lane and no recon box. The 11 is in a yellow door box.

summary: Indian Ocean haven on the equator at 60°E, population 3, blank name. The first move names it and opens door 11. A red region line runs north-south along the African coast, west of the haven. No sea lane and no recon box.
